SSS51.name: 星轨魟
SSS51.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with a crisp bevelled margin, a slightly protruding snout tip, a row of luminous pores along each wing edge, a long whip-like tail
SSS51.fins: wing-like pectoral fins with a straight leading edge, a small dorsal fin near the tail base
SSS51.markings: even arcs of dots sweeping across the disc, a single bright node at the center of the back

SSS52.name: 时刻鲳
SSS52.form: a deep oval body with a keeled belly, a small blunt head, a small terminal mouth, a short caudal peduncle
SSS52.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a matching anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, short pectoral fins
SSS52.markings: a fine grid of parallel lines across the flank, a single ring near the gill cover

SSS53.name: 时间龙鱼
SSS53.form: a flattened angular head, a pair of antler-like horns, a single row of ring plates along the belly, a pair of jointed barbels at the mouth
SSS53.fins: a long ribbon-like dorsal fin, long trailing pectoral fins, a tapered tail fin
SSS53.markings: stacked chevron bands along the flank, a single loop near the tail

SSS54.name: 终焉鲨
SSS54.form: a heavy deep-chested build, a blunt squared snout, rows of small serrated teeth, gill slits ringed by eroded grooves
SSS54.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long falcate pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin
SSS54.markings: worn longitudinal grooves along the flank, a broken band at the tail base

SSS55.name: 永恒鲸
SSS55.form: a broad rounded head with a gentle dome, deep parallel throat grooves, a heavy tapering rear, a ringed ridge along the back
SSS55.fins: long slender pectoral fins, a broad notched tail fluke
SSS55.markings: faint concentric rings over the crown, a long stilled crease along the flank

SSS56.name: 原初蛇颈龙
SSS56.form: a small pointed head atop a long thick neck, a rounded barrel torso, deep short throat grooves, a heavy short rear taper
SSS56.fins: a pair of broad paddle-like flippers, a small low dorsal ridge
SSS56.markings: a row of fossil-like imprints along the flank, faint joint rings on the neck

SSS57.name: 星尘巨魟
SSS57.form: a huge diamond-shaped disc with faceted plate edges, a row of glowing nodes along the wing rim, a single horn-like snout ridge, a long thin tail
SSS57.fins: broad wing-like pectoral fins with crisp angular tips
SSS57.markings: sparse scattered points across the disc, a band of dots along the wing edge

SSS58.name: 时光褶皱·虚空鲸
SSS58.form: a massive oval body with deep folded pleats along the flank, a smooth domed head, a long narrow jaw, a short rear taper
SSS58.fins: long curving pectoral fins, a wide tail fluke
SSS58.markings: layered fold lines across the flank, a single hollow ring on the crown

SSS59.name: 纪元褶皱·深渊鲸
SSS59.form: a heavy broad body with stacked layered ridges along the back, a blunt squared head, a deep-set small eye
SSS59.fins: short broad pectoral fins, a large notched tail fluke
SSS59.markings: terraced ridge lines along the back, a single eye-like ring behind the head

SSS60.name: 逆熵巨鱿
SSS60.form: a long tapered mantle with reversed overlapping scales, a smooth matte surface, ten arms of graded length, a pair of long filaments
SSS60.fins: a pair of triangular fins flaring from the mantle tip
SSS60.markings: descending chevrons along the mantle, a ring of dots at the arm bases
